entries.name: Mithril CEX Legal Freeze Decision

entries.name: Mithril CEX Live Balance Monitoring

entries.author: Mithril

entries.name: Mithril CEX Recovery Payment Settlement

No network, no target execution, no probe, no submission.

entries.name: Mithril Bug Bounty VRF Ops (case-scoped)
entries.description: One owning profile per Bug Bounty challenge (mithril-bb-<id>). Each tick runs the deterministic Mithril public review against every case the profile owns from data/canonical/challenges.json, writes receipts to R2 under bounty-vrf/<case>/ and Drive jklux, and writes the status row back into the shared Challenge Log via the Drive API (rclone public-client token refresh; no browser UI). Secondary in-scope repositories are separate canonical cases with a lowercase letter suffix (BB-0002b); they are reviewed and archived but do not carry a sheet row.
